category.hair.intro: From a shaved head to long hair. Each style shows who it suits, the daily effort and what the barber will do.
category.beards.intro: For beards, growth matters more than face shape. A style that needs full growth looks patchy on patchy growth.
category.moustaches.intro: Pairs with any beard except Van Dyke, Circle Beard, Balbo and Anchor Beard, which have their own moustache.
category.colours.intro: The level number tells the barber which shade to use from any brand. Every colour starts with an allergy question.
category.looks.intro: Complete hair and beard sets. Pick one and it fills My Look in one tap.

about.title: About you
about.description: Answer a few quick questions to see the styles that suit you first.
about.intro: Answer what you know. Skip the rest.
about.face.question: What is your face shape?
about.face.hint: Push your hair back and look straight into a mirror.
about.face.help.Oval: A bit longer than wide. Soft jaw.
about.face.help.Round: Same length and width. Soft jaw, full cheeks.
about.face.help.Square: Strong, wide jaw. Forehead and jaw about the same width.
about.hairType.question: What is your hair type?
about.hairType.hint: How your hair falls when it is dry and unstyled.
about.hairAmount.label: Hair amount
about.hairAmount.question: How much hair do you have?
about.hairAmount.hint: Thin hair shows the scalp through on top.
about.growth.question: How does your beard grow?
about.growth.hint: Think of how it fills in after about a week without shaving.
about.growth.help.Patchy: Gaps on the cheeks or between beard and moustache.
about.growth.help.Medium: Fills in, with a few thin spots.
about.skin.question: What is your skin tone?
about.skin.hint: Used to suggest hair colours that suit you.
about.grey.question: How much grey hair do you have?
about.grey.hint: Used to suggest hair colours that cover or soften grey.
